method: Original Nogova R01WarCry direct developer harness, copied profiles, --nosound, synchronization validation. All10 original bridge transforms queried without moving objects. Four selected standing views across both bridge locations: deck cameras1.8m above original mesh and bank cameras1.8m above queried terrain. Explicit simulation clock0 before each frozen action. Not Steam launch, physical traversal, mission completion or all-placement acceptance.
costMethod: RTX4060Ti, auto/TAA100%, one bounce, RT sun/cloud shadows, AO/water/volumetrics off. Native warm10 then Off/On/On/Off settle4/sample6;1080p deck/bank and1440p bank. Separate1080p bank forced-CPU warm20/settle8/min45seconds per interval, at least3 fresh frame/GI-stage timestamps, bounded120seconds. No builds/heavy census/other game during timing. Medians of each interval, then means of paired medians; scene workloads are not isolated material costs.
preservedContracts: Original v3, qualification functions, existing region entries, enhanced-material safety test, shaders, transport/filter/ray budgets, alpha overlay/depth/ordering/lighting, geometry/UVs/normals/samplers, assets, settings and privateDLSS unchanged. Only existing material data and scoped safety regression extended.
